en: Fixed plugin LSP servers receiving literal `${user_config.*}` and `${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}` placeholders in `initializationOptions` and `settings` instead of substituted values or manifest defaults
zh: 修复 plugin LSP 服务器在 `initializationOptions` 和 `settings` 中收到字面量 `${user_config.*}` 和 `${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}` 占位符，而非替换后的值或清单默认值的问题
